fixes.title: Dentist to confirm: All basic treatment for active caries and periodontal disease completed
fixes.why: The clinical note raises no concern here. The Guide requires basic caries and periodontal treatment to be completed before a crown request.

clause.quote: All basic treatment addressing any existing active biological disease (caries and periodontal) must be completed before submitting requests for crowns.

fixes.title: Dentist to confirm: Tooth meets the "extensively restored" definition
fixes.why: The clinical note raises no concern here. CDCP defines "extensively restored" by tooth type; the dentist confirms which definition applies and that it is met.

fixes.title: Dentist to confirm 7 criteria: Restorability criteria confirmed by the treating dentist
fixes.why: The clinical note raises no concern here. Four of these are radiographic measurements the dentist makes on the film; CDCP requires each to be met.

fixes.title: Confirm the procedure code against the CDCP grid
fixes.why: 27215 is a crowns code but is not in the Schedule B crown list (27201, 27211, 27301) on the 2026 grid. The grid is the authority: confirm the code before submitting.
